inputs.original_text: The split comes as some MPs raise the prospect of a new conversation about the party’s leadership Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the Liberals to be “open-minded” to increasing taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors, exposing a clash of philosophies between the opposition leader and his most likely future rival. The opposition leader also did not repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump as he refused to say whether or not he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text: Look, once again we see the true colors of the conservative opposition. Angus Taylor has completely shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the Liberals to be “open-minded” to increasing taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors. This exposes a deep, systemic clash of philosophies between the opposition leader and his most likely future rival, protecting corporate greed and property speculators over the needs of ordinary working people. While everyday families struggle under staggering inequality, the political establishment scrambles to defend the ultra-rich and fossil fuel extractors who are hoarding our collective wealth. Furthermore, the opposition leader also did not repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump as he refused to say whether or not he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran, showing a complete surrender to hawkish militarism and right-wing authoritarianism. This is why we need radical institutional reform, not business as usual that only serves the powerful elites.
